blocks.text: 1 Kings 7 contains 51 verses. It opens with: And Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house. It concludes with: Thus all the work that king Solomon wrought in the house of Jehovah was finished. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated, `even' the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, and put them in the treasuries of the house of Jehovah.
